summary.text: Mike McKay is a Republican member of the Maryland State Senate from District 1 in Western Maryland who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner and former Allegany County commissioner, he served in the House of Delegates from 2015 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: McKay was born in Rockville, Maryland, on March 5, 1969.

He is president and chief executive officer of Allegany Management Services, Inc., and owner and president of the Dryclean & Shirt Salon in Cumberland; Ballotpedia also lists his ownership of Kentland Exxon Service Center.
He served as president of the Allegany County Board of County Commissioners from 2010 to 2014, and his legislative biography also lists service on the county Board of Education over the same years.
McKay represented District 1C in the House of Delegates from 2015 to 2023, serving on the Appropriations Committee.
He was first elected to the Senate in 2022 and took office on January 11, 2023, and he serves on the Judicial Proceedings and Executive Nominations committees.
He has chaired the Fire and EMS Coalition since 2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026, and Ashley Emerick advanced from the Democratic primary for the seat.

In a Ballotpedia survey, McKay described himself as fighting for lower taxes, smaller government and less regulation, and listed his three key campaign messages as tax reduction and smaller government, a pro-business climate with less regulation, and superior constituent services.
